M-MCP.NAME: MCP stdio server
M-MCP.purpose: Expose the MyGRACE tool catalog to MCP clients over stdio with a PATH-free CLI launcher, strict argument validation and full output passthrough (ADR-7, ADR-8).

fn-resolveLauncher.PURPOSE: MYGRACE_BIN then process.execPath plus src/grace.ts then mygrace on PATH.

fn-resolveTimeoutMs.PURPOSE: Parse MYGRACE_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS with a safe default.

fn-runCli.PURPOSE: execFile the launcher; capture stdout/stderr, timeout, maxBuffer, spawn errors.

fn-createMcpServer.PURPOSE: Server with ListTools/CallTool handlers driven by the catalog.

CrossLink.relation: single tool catalog, schemas and argv mapping

contract.purpose: Expose the MyGRACE tool catalog to MCP clients over stdio with a PATH-free CLI launcher, strict argument validation and full output passthrough (ADR-7, ADR-8).

param.name: content
param.description: CLI text output (stdout and stderr preserved on failure).

error.description: Structured validation error listing the offending fields.

notes.note-1: The server is a transport adapter, not a second implementation: every tool maps to a CLI command (21 tools including mygrace_ci, mygrace_trace, mygrace_impact, mygrace_next, mygrace_projects, mygrace_integrations, mygrace_diagram, mygrace_capsule_list and mygrace_capsule_run).
notes.note-2: The launcher works from a plain checkout without a global mygrace binary or PATH entry.
notes.note-3: Failure details are returned with isError instead of a stack trace.
